newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Causeway chairman, director sell shares.
newsitem.headline: Causeway chairman, director sell shares.

text.p: Trading firm Causeway Investment Ltd said it had been informed that its chairman, Tunku Osman Ahmad, and one of its directors, Alan Ong, were negotiating "with certain parties" over the possible sale of their stakes in the company.
"The number of shares under negotiation is 9.82 million shares which represents 13.19 percent of the share capital of the company," Causeway said in a statement issued on Friday.
The statement did not say who are the possible buyers.
It also said it knew of no reason for the recent price movement in the company's shares.
Causeway's shares were last traded two cents higher at Singapore $1.51 on a turnover of 1.02 million shares.
